facts: Water-soaked black lesions on leaves and stems. Lesions expand rapidly and the entire leaf becomes necrotic. White sporulation on leaves. Dark brown lesions on fruit; soft rot and disintegration of fruits.

Blight appears on foliage as light-pale green water soaked dead area. The lesions are wet in morning and dried, shriveled in daylight. It enlarges rapidly until entire leaves are killed and exposing all the fruits for infection.

In moist and cloudy weather a downy white fungus develops near the outer margin of lesion on underside of the leaves. Green and ripe fruit affected by the blight appear as greenish brown and internal tissues become spongy with bad odour.

Grow resistant variety/hybrid Arka Abhed F1. Avoid planting tomatoes in the same field every year. Remove infected plant parts. Ensure enough space between plants and stake them. Leaf curl disease is characterized by severe stunting of the plants with downward rolling and crinkling of the leaves. The newly emerging leaves exhibit slight yellow colouration and later they also show curling symptoms.

Raise the nursery under a net of sufficient mesh size to keep out whiteflies. Select seed from disease-free healthy plants.
